tldr: 最近交易日（8/21 週五）加權指數漲約 290 點收 45,224 點站回 45,000 關卡，外資回補、貨櫃三雄領漲。
市場迎接重量級一週：輝達美股週三盤後財報與 8/27 登場的聯準會 Jackson Hole 年會，恐重設利率預期。
台積電 2026 CoWoS 產能售罄，輝達、博通吃下二至三成擴產大部分，AI 先進封裝續為主流題材。
金管會優化銀行與金控財報準則，並為壽險業接軌 IFRS 17 與新清償制度提供過渡緩衝。
在財管中心政策下銀行加速搶攻高資產客群，中信 × BCG 報告揭示台灣超高資產客群快速成長。

items.title_zh: 台股週五收 45,224 點、外資回補站回 45,000 關卡
items.title_en: TAIEX closes Friday at 45,224 as foreign buyers return, reclaiming the 45,000 mark
items.summary_zh: 最近交易日（8/21 週五）加權指數開低走高、低量收漲約 290 點至 45,224 點，重返 45,000 點。三大法人合計買超約 331 億元，外資及陸資買超約 283 億元；台積電漲 35 元收 2,410 元，貨櫃三雄勁揚，金融與航運股助攻。資金在 AI 權值股之外轉進景氣循環族群，盤面題材輪動、多方氣勢延續進入週末。
items.summary_en: In the most recent trading session (Fri, Aug 21) the benchmark opened lower but closed up around 290 points at 45,224 on thin volume, retaking 45,000. The three major institutions net-bought about NT$331 billion, with foreign investors adding roughly NT$283 billion. TSMC rose NT$35 to NT$2,410, while container shippers led the gains, signalling a rotation into cyclicals alongside AI heavyweights heading into the weekend.

items.title_zh: 本週焦點：輝達財報與 Jackson Hole 央行年會
items.title_en: Week ahead: markets brace for Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole
items.summary_zh: 台股週一開盤在即，市場聚焦事件與數據密集的一週。重頭戲為輝達美股週三盤後財報，以及 8/27 登場的聯準會 Jackson Hole 全球央行年會，主席談話可能重設利率預期。市場關注長天期殖利率能否續降、高beta科技與半導體族群是否守穩支撐，牽動台灣 AI 供應鏈的評價面與後續資金動能。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan markets reopening Monday, investors are positioning for a data- and event-heavy week. Focus falls on Nvidia's results due after the US close on Wednesday and the Fed's Jackson Hole symposium from Aug 27, where Chair remarks could reset rate expectations. Traders are watching whether long-end yields keep easing and whether high-beta tech and semiconductor names hold support amid valuation pressure on the AI supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電 2026 CoWoS 產能售罄、輝達博通吃下多數擴產
items.title_en: TSMC's 2026 CoWoS capacity sells out as Nvidia and Broadcom book most of the expansion
items.summary_zh: 先進封裝需求遠超供給，台積電 2026 年 CoWoS 產能規劃擴增二至三成、月產能上看約 12.5 萬片。新增量能在開出前多已被輝達與博通預訂，僅留部分配置給聯發科等客戶。大摩並將 2026 年輝達 CoWoS-L 需求上修至約 70 萬片。此指引凸顯 AI 硬體建置需求續強，為台積電與整條台廠先進封裝供應鏈的中長期成長定錨。
items.summary_en: Advanced-packaging demand is running well ahead of supply, with TSMC guided to expand CoWoS output by 20%-30% to roughly 125,000 wafers a month in 2026. Most of the new capacity has already been reserved by Nvidia and Broadcom, leaving only a slice for others such as MediaTek. Morgan Stanley lifted its 2026 Nvidia CoWoS-L demand estimate to around 700,000 wafers, underscoring the durability of the AI hardware build-out.

items.title_zh: AI 題材由 GPU 外溢至散熱、電源與先進封裝
items.title_en: AI theme broadens from GPUs to cooling, power and advanced packaging
items.summary_zh: 2026 年市場焦點自 GPU、AI 伺服器擴散至整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB／CCL、電源供應與 48V 高壓供電、HBM／CoWoS、矽光子與高速傳輸。由於部分低毛利後段封裝製程外包，AI 受惠族群由運算晶片向更廣泛台廠零組件延伸。此趨勢帶動散熱、材料、電源與連接介面等次族群輪番表現，使 AI 供應鏈的成長動能更為分散而全面。
items.summary_en: Market focus in 2026 is spreading beyond GPUs and AI servers to rack-scale systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply and 48V high-voltage delivery, HBM/CoWoS, silicon photonics and high-speed transmission. As lower-margin back-end packaging steps are partly outsourced, the set of Taiwanese hardware names riding the AI capex wave keeps widening, spreading gains across materials, thermal, power and interconnect suppliers.

items.title_zh: 金管會優化銀行與金控財報編製準則
items.title_en: FSC refines financial-report standards for banks and financial holdings
items.summary_zh: 金管會 8 月中修正公開發行銀行及金融控股公司財務報告編製準則，以提升資訊揭露的透明度與可比較性。相關調整為金融業接軌新一代會計與清償能力制度鋪路，促使機構提升資產負債表揭露品質。此舉為後續多項新制上路預作準備，牽動整體金融業體質與監理節奏，也讓投資人更易比較各行庫的財務體質與經營成果。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission amended in mid-August the preparation standards for financial reports of publicly issued banks and financial holding companies, aiming to lift disclosure transparency and comparability. The changes form part of the groundwork as the sector moves toward next-generation accounting and solvency frameworks, nudging institutions toward cleaner, more consistent balance-sheet reporting ahead of a broader run of new rules due to take effect.

items.title_zh: 壽險業接軌 IFRS 17 與新清償制度、獲過渡緩衝
items.title_en: Life insurers get transition relief as sector converges toward IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime
items.summary_zh: 主管機關推出分階段暫行措施，協助壽險業平順接軌 IFRS 17 與新一代風險資本制度，包括為金控旗下壽險減壓、允許部分業者延後申報資本適足率。相關安排旨在避免接軌過程出現一次性衝擊，給予壽險業更充裕的資本重建與體質調整空間。此為壽險業迎接明年多項新制上路的重要鋪墊，牽動業者資本規劃與商品策略。
items.summary_en: Regulators have rolled out phased measures to smooth life insurers' adoption of IFRS 17 and the incoming risk-based capital framework, including relief that eases capital pressure for holding-company-owned insurers and allows several firms to defer capital-adequacy filings. The steps aim to prevent disruptive one-off hits as the industry transitions, giving insurers more runway to rebuild capital buffers.

items.title_zh: 中信 × BCG 報告：台灣超高資產客群快速成長
items.title_en: CTBC-BCG report maps Taiwan's fast-growing ultra-high-net-worth pool
items.summary_zh: 中國信託與波士頓顧問公司（BCG）發布的財富洞察報告指出，台灣超高資產客群規模龐大且快速增長，核心投資組合約以股票與 ETF、債券型商品各半配置，投資積極但配置相對均衡。各銀行加速深化私人銀行、信託與傳承規劃服務，搶攻高資產家庭財管商機，也呼應政府將台灣打造為區域財富管理中心的政策方向。
items.summary_en: A wealth-insight study by CTBC and Boston Consulting Group highlights a large and rapidly expanding ultra-high-net-worth client base in Taiwan, with core portfolios split roughly evenly between equities/ETFs and bond products — an actively invested but relatively balanced allocation. Banks are racing to deepen private-banking, trust and succession services, positioning Taiwan as a regional wealth-management hub for high-asset families.

items.title_zh: 財管中心政策推升銀行搶攻高資產客群
items.title_en: Banks intensify competition for high-asset clients under the wealth-management hub push
items.summary_zh: 在高資產財富管理方案下，符合資格的銀行可為資產達新臺幣 1 億元以上客戶提供更多元的商品與諮詢服務，各銀行紛紛強化私人銀行分級與優惠條件以搶占市占。亞洲資產管理中心計畫則將政策資源導向人才、商品與跨境能力建置，深化本地高資產家庭市場。此趨勢有助壯大台灣財富管理生態，也帶動信託、結構型商品與海外資產配置需求。
items.summary_en: Under the regulator's high-asset wealth-management scheme, banks meeting the threshold can offer NT$100-million-plus clients a wider menu of products and advisory services, and lenders are sharpening private-banking tiers and preferential terms to win share. The Asia Asset Management Center initiative is channelling policy support toward talent, products and cross-border capabilities, deepening the onshore market for high-net-worth families.
